method: Recorded injuries use the 1,545 reviewed dashboard injury rows.
Time-loss status uses final classification. Days lost use known time_loss_days only.

headline.label: Recorded injuries
headline.formula: count(final classified eligible injury rows, including undated)

headline.label: Overall incidence
headline.formula: pooled recorded injuries / pooled exposure hours * 1000

headline.label: Incidence
headline.formula: pooled final Time Loss injuries / pooled exposure hours * 1000

headline.label: Mean severity
headline.formula: known-duration Time Loss days lost / known-duration Time Loss injuries

headline.label: Median severity
headline.formula: median known-duration Time Loss days lost

headline.label: Burden
headline.formula: known-duration Time Loss days lost / pooled exposure hours * 1000

limitations: V3 injury successor and Welsh exact-date fixture correction are bound to private immutable evidence.

analysis_window.basis: Private V3 injury successor with reviewed Welsh exact-date fixture correction and V6 exposure.
